descriptions.exhibit/index.html: We Are Here: the exhibit's rooms, each one a perception trick shown and then revealed, built from public domain plates.
descriptions.playbook/examples/index.html: Builds: weather on twos, scatter mosaics, piled type, morphing clouds, caption lines, projectors and caustics, each live.
descriptions.superframe/room/index.html: Make room: say what you want in words and the engine turns it into image and sound with its own nodes, in your browser.
descriptions.visualizer/web/grid.html: Struck grid: the theme's score on framed cells; a struck cell fills with ink and empties from its centre in time.
descriptions.visualizer/web/index.html: Sounding: a seabed seen through moving water, with caustics and wavefronts struck by the music's onsets.

the author, 2026-11-02: "there's not really supposed to be heroes and panels and pills and squares and containers"; the hand loses its pill and its controls their rings, and keeps contrast with a halo of the ground
